content.thinking:
Only 1.0s for 120 traces — that seems too fast for large instances. Probably most loads fail (invalid) or the prepares mostly get denied. Let me add statistics: count how many prepares were attempted, how many prepared/denied, and the max compile time.

Let me instrument the fuzzer to report stats.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
p='/workspace/tmp/fuzz.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""        if op=='prepare':
            if out.get('status')=='prepared':""","""        if op=='prepare':
            stats[out.get('status','?')]=stats.get(out.get('status','?'),0)+1
            if out.get('status')=='prepared':
                stats['maxplan']=max(stats.get('maxplan',0),len(out['plan']['trees']))""")
s=s.replace("""fails=[]""","""fails=[]
stats={}""")
s=s.replace("""            out=h(cmd)""","""            t1=time.time(); out=h(cmd); dt=time.time()-t1
            if dt>1.0: stats['slow']=stats.get('slow',0)+1; print('SLOWCMD %.2fs'%dt, json.dumps(cmd)[:200])
            stats['maxcmd']=max(stats.get('maxcmd',0),dt)""")
s=s.replace("""print('trace fails',len(fails),'exceptions',bad_count,'time %.1f'%(time.time()-t0))""",
"""print('trace fails',len(fails),'exceptions',bad_count,'time %.1f'%(time.time()-t0))
print('stats',stats)""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PYEOF
timeout 2400 python3 -B tmp/fuzz.py 150 2>&1 | tail -12
